title: EXP-021-R4 — Clean Replay: Static Caption Recovery Across Ordinary Close/Reopen
objective: In a fresh OpenCode/worker context distinct from EXP-021, create one new User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab04`, perform exactly one Static creation operation producing a visibly verified component named `FX_StaticCaptionStatic04`, establish an exact pre-Caption comparison baseline, change only that Static's Caption to `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4`, perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save to clean state, close the target exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control, reopen it exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context, and verify that the same User-scoped Form recovers the Static with the exact Caption and unchanged recorded comparison properties. Require rendered Static text after reopen as corroborating display evidence, recording its literal text separately from the exact Caption property; a trailing colon does not make the Caption comparison fail. No Colon state and the cause of rendering differences remain unproven. Treat the result only as UI-level recovery across this tested weak close-only boundary; make no Forms-database durability, serialization, cache-eviction, unload, or internal-instance claim.

acceptance_checks.description: Before target mutation, record the worker/session identity or harness-provided freshness fact establishing a fresh OpenCode/worker context distinct from EXP-021. Preserve the existing Designer/browser client: worker freshness does not authorize replacing or restarting it or resetting recovery limits. If freshness cannot be established, preserve any observations, stop this qualifying replay, and do not promote to replay_verified. Inspect and record the current visible Form tabs/dialogs and dirty-state indicators, including any inherited `FX_StaticNoColonLab01` state, without investigating No Colon or changing earlier artifacts. Preserve inherited dirty Forms and uncommitted dialogs: do not Save, discard, close, delete, or modify them. Stop blocked if session establishment, creation, or the target-only Save/close/reopen workflow cannot proceed without disturbing that state; any cleanup requires separate operator authorization outside this experiment. Visibly prove a usable live Mongoose workflow and Designer Editing Scope=User, then use the supported Select Form Name filter in case-insensitive mode with a visible known-existing positive control to prove `FX_StaticCaptionLab04` has zero matching rows. If one permitted pre-mutation session-establishment sequence is needed, disclose it and repeat these guards afterward.

Create exactly one User-scoped classic BuildFromScratch Form `FX_StaticCaptionLab04` using the replay-verified EXP-019-R2 fresh-dialog rendered Classic/Build from Scratch selection prefix, followed by the separately verified basic-form creation procedure from the first Build-from-Scratch page onward. Do not describe the entire composed creation path as replay-verified. Require Save Template visibly unchecked, and capture the target's loaded clean state plus visible Name + ScopeType + ScopeName identity.

Perform exactly one Static creation operation, name it `FX_StaticCaptionStatic04`, and before the tested Caption mutation capture an exact property-grid/accessibility baseline for component Name, Caption, Type, From Device Master, Layout Size, Justification, and every other comparison property exposed by the verified component workflow. Keep any rendered canvas text separate and optional at this checkpoint.

After AC-3, change only the Static Caption to exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4`. Capture exact Caption, unchanged comparison properties, and the expected dirty Designer state. Pre-reopen canvas rendering is optional corroboration only and is not required to pass this check.

Perform exactly one ordinary Designer Save after the Caption edit and prove Designer returns clean while `FX_StaticCaptionStatic04` remains present with Caption exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4` and every recorded non-Caption comparison property remains equal to the AC-3 baseline.

Close `FX_StaticCaptionLab04` exactly once through its ordinary Form-tab close control and visibly prove the target tab is closed with no unsaved-change or unexpected prompt. Record that no explicit unload, Regenerate, preference change, client replacement, or post-mutation session-establishment action occurred.
Reopen the target exactly once through Designer Form-menu recent forms in the same Designer/client context and visibly verify matching User-scoped Form identity using Name + ScopeType + ScopeName.

After reopen, verify `FX_StaticCaptionStatic04` is present with Caption property exactly `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4` and every recorded non-Caption comparison property equals the AC-3 baseline. The exact Caption property is the decisive value. Capture and transcribe the literal rendered Static text separately as corroborating display evidence: either `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4` or `Static Caption Close Only Replay 4:` supports the displayed Caption, and a trailing colon alone does not fail this check. Record any other discrepancy explicitly rather than silently normalizing it. Do not infer No Colon state, its persistence, the cause of punctuation, internal instance identity, or complete component cardinality.

Final read-only audit must reconcile documented fresh worker context distinct from EXP-021, exactly one Static creation operation (not a complete component-inventory claim), exactly one ordinary Save, one target Form-tab close, one recent-forms reopen, no deliberate target-property mutation after AC-3 except Caption, zero explicit unloads, zero Regenerates, zero preference changes, zero client replacements, and zero post-mutation authentication/session-establishment actions. A live case-insensitive Select Form check must show exactly one `FX_StaticCaptionLab04`; a session-expired or recovery-obstructed inventory read is invalid evidence and blocks replay verification rather than authorizing another recovery attempt. Repository changes must be confined to the EXP-021-R4 record and `evidence/EXP-021-R4/`.

initial_instruction: Before any target mutation, establish and record fresh OpenCode/worker context distinct from EXP-021, preserve the existing Designer/browser client and inherited dirty state, and complete AC-1. A new record is expected (`new_record=true`): create it within the declared record path when needed; do not repeatedly search Git for it. Keep the exact Caption property distinct from rendered canvas text, including a possible trailing colon. Do not search for or infer No Colon. Report the bounded task result to the coordinator and stop; worker freshness does not reset experiment or recovery limits.
notes: Proposed by the coordinator after run R-20261006-125233-BECN. Rationale: EXP-021 is an accepted single observation that a Static component Caption recovered across one ordinary Designer Save, Form-tab close, and recent-forms reopen, but it is not replay-verified. EXP-021-R2 never established a qualifying replay because its preflight remained incomplete, EXP-021-R3 is already reserved on disk, and EXP-022 is blocked on the separate No Colon property and must not be worked around. The smallest useful next experiment is therefore a fresh independent replay of EXP-021 on a new FX_ Form using a new replay ID.
